AUTHOR: R. J. M. Veiga
TITLE: Fine-Grained Fish Classification From Small to Large Datasets With Vision Transformers
REGION: Multiple: Australia (OzFish, QUT), Gulf of Mexico (SEAMAPD21), NW Mediterranean off Barcelona (OBSEA), Adriatic (Croatian), Taiwan (Fish4Knowledge), others
SPECIES: Fine-grained species/genus/family classes; e.g. OzFish 425 classes, SEAMAPD21 110, OBSEA 25, F4K 23
DATA: 14 public datasets (19 experiments): Large-Scale Fish Segmentation & Classification, BDIndigenousFish2019, Croatian Fish, Fish-Gres, Fish-Pak, Fish4Knowledge, FishNet, FishNet Open Images, OBSEA, OzFish, QUT, SEAMAPD21, WildFish, WildFish++; cropped single-fish images
D2: 70/20/10 (train/val/test), seed 42; predefined splits for FishNet and FishNet Open Images
D_EV: Sec. IV-A: 'a uniform split strategy was implemented with a generator seed of 42... 10% were set aside for model testing, 20% for validation, and 70% for training.'
R_EV: Table 3 footnote: values 'from unseen data... either by the available published splits or by using a uniform split strategy, consistently considering 10% for testing.'
C_EV: no statement found (classification-only; top-1 accuracy, no per-instance score threshold or reject option reported)
E_EV: Sec. IV-A: 'metrics corresponding to the top-1 accuracy of the combiner over the test set'
ARCH: FGVC-PIM with Swin Transformer backbone + FPN, Weakly Supervised Selector, GCN combiner
METR: top-1 accuracy, macro/weighted precision, recall, F1, multiclass MCC
NOTE: INCL=Y because own results reported on monitoring-programme field datasets (OzFish BRUV, SEAMAPD21 BRUV, OBSEA observatory, Croatian diver/underwater footage) alongside benchmark/non-underwater sets (supermarket, market, WildFish, QUT, FishNet). Per-dataset accuracy values are in Table 3/5 which did not extract from PDF text. Split is uniform random on cropped images (multiple crops from same frames/videos likely in train and test; not discussed). OzFish/SEAMAPD21 not using predefined split. WSS confidence scores are internal feature selection only -> not C. FishNet Open Images noted to contain >10,000 duplicates, removal not stated (D3 NR).
